birth.stop: Anchay, birth at the mill of Charbouilla
birth.date_confidence: attested; day and year given by both Wikipedia editions and Wikidata Q277616. The hamlet of Anchay lies in the commune of Lavans-sur-Valouse, merged into Saint-Hymetiere-sur-Valouse on 1 January 2019; the coordinate is the commune centre, since the mill itself is not separately mapped. The first pass's population figure of 148 was the 1999 census and is dropped.

stops.stop: The Tuileries, packer to the Empress
stops.date_confidence: contradiction carried and one branch shown impossible. fr.wikipedia gives 1852, Encyclopedia.com gave 1853, en.wikipedia gives no year at all.
